data.body:
[P2] Keep invocation-end status consistent with the wrapper outcome

For a small successful result, no terminal checkpoint is sent. If an `on_invocation_end` hook consumes the remaining budget, this check raises `InvocationDeadlineExceeded` after End hooks have received `SUCCEEDED`. Both bundled OTel plugins export the terminal workflow span before `force_flush()`, so a slow flush causes Lambda to retry an execution already reported as finished. Ensure the outcome cannot change after End receives terminal status—for example, acknowledge the terminal output before End while the batcher is still running—and add a slow-End integration test asserting both wrapper and telemetry outcomes.
